verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents its own rules for automatic error assignment, for example routing all errors from src/components/cart to the Cart Team. It also documents dashboard discard rules synced to SDKs, and integrations that act automatically on error activity (PagerDuty incidents, webhook messages). The rule engine shown in evidence is narrow: rules mainly drive assignment or discard, with no documented general condition-to-action rule builder. Missing for 10: a general rule engine with configurable conditions and arbitrary action types, documentation of rule conditions and options beyond file-path assignment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: assigning all errors that originate from files in the src/components/cart directory to the “Cart Team” or an individual collaborator. BugSnag allows you to create rules to automate this process.
